source: scripts/gen_lms_vectors.py. The first six cases are RFC 8554 appendix F's two and RFC 9858 appendix A's four, read from the RFCs' text. The rest are from a signer written from the RFCs' pseudocode, which first reproduced RFC 9858's public keys and signatures from their published SEED and I (the one-time signature only, for its H=20 case); they are that implementation's outputs, not published values.
